text: Hvad er klokken, når en dansker siger »halv otte«?
gloss: What time is it when a Dane says "halv otte"? — 07.30: Danish counts toward the coming hour, so "half eight" is half an hour before eight (not 08.30 as in English).

text: Fjerner du det første bogstav i »skål«, står der en grøntsag. Hvilken?
gloss: Remove the first letter of "skål" and a vegetable remains. Which? — Kål (cabbage): s-kål.

text: En »tier« og en »femmer« ligger i lommen. Hvor mange kroner er det i alt?
gloss: A "tier" (10-krone coin) and a "femmer" (5-krone coin) are in the pocket. How many kroner in all? — 15: Danish slang names coins by their value plus -er.

text: Hvem er din »farmor«?
gloss: Who is your "farmor"? — Your father's mother: Danish builds the word from far (father) + mor (mother).

text: Hvilket tegn kalder danskerne et »snabel-a«?
gloss: Which sign do Danes call a "snabel-a" (trunk-a)? — @, the at sign in e-mail addresses.

text: Hvilken ret med kartofler og persillesovs blev i 2014 kåret til Danmarks nationalret?
gloss: Which dish with potatoes and parsley sauce was voted Denmark's national dish in 2014? — Stegt flæsk (fried pork belly) med persillesovs.

text: Hvilken figur brænder man traditionelt på bålet sankthansaften?
gloss: Which figure is traditionally burned on the bonfire on Midsummer Eve (Sankt Hans)? — A witch.

text: Hvilken dansk ø ligger i Østersøen, tættere på Sverige end på resten af Danmark?
gloss: Which Danish island lies in the Baltic, closer to Sweden than to the rest of Denmark? — Bornholm.

text: Hvilken fejlkode viser en hjemmeside, når siden ikke findes?
gloss: Which error code does a website show when the page does not exist? — 404 (Not Found); 200 means OK, 301 a redirect, 500 a server error.

text: Hvilken sport har danske Viktor Axelsen to gange vundet OL-guld i?
gloss: Which sport has Denmark's Viktor Axelsen won Olympic gold in twice? — Badminton (Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024).

text: Hvilket dansk band fik i 1997 et verdenshit med »Barbie Girl«?
gloss: Which Danish band had a worldwide hit in 1997 with "Barbie Girl"? — Aqua.

text: Hvem er onkel til Rip, Rap og Rup?
gloss: Who is the uncle of Huey, Dewey and Louie (Rip, Rap og Rup)? — Anders And (Donald Duck).

text: Hvad hedder den lille bamse, der sejler verden rundt sammen med pingvinen Pingo?
gloss: What is the little bear who sails the world with the penguin Pingo called? — Rasmus Klump, the Danish picture-book bear.

text: Hvilken nordisk gud svinger hammeren Mjølner?
gloss: Which Norse god wields the hammer Mjølner? — Thor.

text: Hvad hedder den kolde risdessert, hvor den, der finder den hele mandel, får en gave?
gloss: What is the cold rice dessert called where whoever finds the whole almond gets a present? — Risalamande, the Danish Christmas dessert.

text: Hvilket af disse danske dyr går i dvale hele vinteren?
gloss: Which of these Danish animals hibernates all winter? — Pindsvin (hedgehog); fox, roe deer and hare stay active.

text: Hvad er hovedingrediensen i hummus?
gloss: What is the main ingredient of hummus? — Chickpeas (kikærter), blended with tahini, lemon and garlic.

text: Hvor mange spillere har et håndboldhold på banen ad gangen?
gloss: How many players does a handball team have on court at a time? — Seven, six court players and a goalkeeper.

text: Hvilken storby ligger lufthavnen Schiphol ved?
gloss: Which big city is Schiphol airport next to? — Amsterdam.

text: Hvilken ost laves traditionelt af fåremælk og er stjernen i en græsk salat?
gloss: Which cheese, traditionally from sheep's milk, is the star of a Greek salad? — Feta.

text: Hvilken streamingtjeneste står bag serierne »Stranger Things« og »Wednesday«?
gloss: Which streaming service is behind the series "Stranger Things" and "Wednesday"? — Netflix.

text: Hvor lang er et maratonløb?
gloss: How long is a marathon? — About 42 km (42.195 km).

text: Hvilken filtype bruges ofte til korte, gentagne billedanimationer på nettet?
gloss: Which file type is often used for short looping image animations on the web? — GIF; PDF is a document, MP3 audio, ZIP an archive.

text: Hvad hedder det grønne tepulver, der bruges i japansk teceremoni og i moderne lattes?
gloss: What is the green tea powder used in the Japanese tea ceremony and in modern lattes called? — Matcha.

text: Hvad kaldes et maleri af opstillede ting som frugt og blomster i en vase?
gloss: What is a painting of arranged objects such as fruit and flowers in a vase called? — Stilleben (still life).

text: Hvilket spil går ud på at grave og bygge i en verden af blokke og passe på creepers?
gloss: Which game is about digging and building in a world of blocks while avoiding creepers? — Minecraft.

text: I hvilken tegnefilm leder klovnefisken Marlin efter sin søn?
gloss: In which animated film does the clownfish Marlin search for his son? — Find Nemo.

text: Hvad kaldes stillingen 40-40 i tennis?
gloss: What is the score 40-40 called in tennis? — Deuce: a player must win two points in a row to take the game.

text: Hvor mange er »halvanden snes«?
gloss: How many is "halvanden snes"? — 30: a "snes" is 20 and "halvanden" is one and a half.

text: Hvilket af disse dyr hedder det samme i ental og flertal?
gloss: Which of these animals has the same word in singular and plural? — Får: et får, to får (køer, heste, grise).

text: Hvilken nordisk gud er tirsdag opkaldt efter?
gloss: Which Norse god is Tuesday named after? — Tyr (tirsdag = Tyrs dag); Thor gave torsdag, Odin onsdag.

text: I hvilken jysk by står runestenene, der kaldes »Danmarks dåbsattest«?
gloss: In which Jutland town stand the runestones called "Denmark's birth certificate"? — Jelling.

text: Hvilken dato holder danskerne grundlovsdag?
gloss: Which date do Danes keep Constitution Day? — 5 June (the constitution of 1849).

text: Danmark vandt EM i fodbold i 1992. Hvilket land blev slået i finalen?
gloss: Denmark won the 1992 European football championship. Which country lost the final? — Germany, 2-0.

text: Hvilken dansk fysiker fik i 1922 Nobelprisen for sin forskning i atomets opbygning?
gloss: Which Danish physicist won the 1922 Nobel Prize for work on atomic structure? — Niels Bohr; his son Aage won in 1975, Finsen won in 1903 for medicine.

text: Hvem tegnede de danske designerstole »Ægget« og »Svanen«?
gloss: Who designed the Danish chairs "the Egg" and "the Swan"? — Arne Jacobsen (1958, SAS Royal Hotel).

text: I hvilket land blev musiktjenesten Spotify grundlagt?
gloss: In which country was the music service Spotify founded? — Sweden (Stockholm, 2006).

text: Hvilket folk byggede bjergbyen Machu Picchu højt oppe i Andesbjergene?
gloss: Which people built the mountain city Machu Picchu in the Andes? — The Incas.

text: Hvilken britisk forfatter skrev dystopien »1984«?
gloss: Which British author wrote the dystopia "1984"? — George Orwell; Huxley wrote "Brave New World".

text: Hvor mange volt er der i en almindelig dansk stikkontakt?
gloss: How many volts are in an ordinary Danish wall socket? — 230 V (110/120 V is the US standard, 400 V three-phase supply).

text: Hvilket krydderi giver karry dens gule farve?
gloss: Which spice gives curry its yellow colour? — Gurkemeje (turmeric).

text: Hvad hedder det jernholdige stof, der binder ilt i de røde blodlegemer?
gloss: What is the iron-containing substance that binds oxygen in red blood cells called? — Haemoglobin.

text: Hvilken dansk fysiker opdagede i 1820, at en elektrisk strøm kan få en kompasnål til at dreje?
gloss: Which Danish physicist discovered in 1820 that an electric current can deflect a compass needle? — H.C. Ørsted, the discovery of electromagnetism.

text: Hvis det er lørdag om tre dage, hvilken dag var det så i forgårs?
gloss: If it is Saturday in three days, what day was it the day before yesterday ("i forgårs")? — Monday: today is Wednesday, and forgårs is two days back.

text: Hvem var i 1963 den første kvinde i rummet?
gloss: Who was the first woman in space, in 1963? — Valentina Tereshkova; Savitskaya (1982) and Ride (1983) came later.

text: Hvad står »S« for i internetadressen »https«?
gloss: What does the "S" stand for in the web address "https"? — Secure: the connection is encrypted.

text: Hvilken fransk filosof sagde »Jeg tænker, altså er jeg«?
gloss: Which French philosopher said "I think, therefore I am"? — René Descartes (cogito ergo sum).

text: Hvilken dansk astronom beregnede i 1676 lysets hastighed ved at følge Jupiters måne Io?
gloss: Which Danish astronomer calculated the speed of light in 1676 by tracking Jupiter's moon Io? — Ole Rømer.

text: Hvilken by var Brasiliens hovedstad lige før Brasília blev indviet i 1960?
gloss: Which city was Brazil's capital just before Brasília was inaugurated in 1960? — Rio de Janeiro (Salvador was capital until 1763).

text: Hvem opdagede elektronen i 1897?
gloss: Who discovered the electron in 1897? — J.J. Thomson; Rutherford found the nucleus, Chadwick the neutron.
